name: Test-First Refactor
description: Write missing tests, then propose a safe refactor guided by the new coverage
when_to_use: When the user wants to refactor code but the target lacks the tests needed to prove behavior is preserved

steps.prompt:
Write focused unit tests that pin down the observable behavior of the following code. Cover happy path, boundary, and error cases. Do not rely on network, clock, or filesystem:

{{input}}
